newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bescorp drops private stock placement.
newsitem.headline: Bescorp drops private stock placement.

text.p: Construction and infrastructure firm Bescorp Industries Bhd said it is aborting a proposed private placement of stock due to "weak local sharemarket sentiments".

In a statement circulated on Monday by the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, the company said that the proposed placement of 1.9 million new shares representing 10 percent of its paid-up share capital would have resulted in an issue price that "would be unjustifiably low" because of the weak market.
Proceeds from the placement were to have been partly to repay bank debt, Bescorp said.
